accepted.command:
set -eu
f='/tmp/发布记录.txt'
b='/tmp/发布记录.txt.bak'
printf '%s\n' 'old' | cmp - "$f"
test ! -e "$b"
cp -p -- "$f" "$b"
printf '%s\n' 'new' >> "$f"
accepted.probe:
set -eu
test -f '/tmp/opsark-receipt-exec-123/done' && test ! -L '/tmp/opsark-receipt-exec-123/done'
cat -- '/tmp/opsark-receipt-exec-123/done'
printf '%s\n' CURRENT_BOOT
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' PROCESS_GROUPS
groups=$(ps -eo pgid=) || exit 125
group=$(awk 'NR==5 {print}' '/tmp/opsark-receipt-exec-123/done') || exit 125
case "$group" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 125;; esac
printf '%s\n' "$groups" | awk -v p="$group" '$1 == p {found=1} END {print found ? p : 0}'
printf '%s\n' FILE_DIGESTS
test -f '/tmp/发布记录.txt' && test ! -L '/tmp/发布记录.txt'
test -f '/tmp/发布记录.txt.bak' && test ! -L '/tmp/发布记录.txt.bak'
sha256sum -- '/tmp/发布记录.txt' '/tmp/发布记录.txt.bak'
sha256sum -- '/tmp/发布记录.txt' '/tmp/发布记录.txt.bak'
printf '%s\n' END
